title: Stevie going to goofland in interviews
summary: He imitates Wonder's tangents in interviews and admits he is doing the same.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Yeah. When he was interviewed, the drummer and I and the bass player used to hang out a lot. And we said, “Ahh Stevie’s going to goofland.” Like the interviewer would ask him a question like you’re doing, and he’d go on a tangent, but he’d go on a tangent and start preaching. So I was saying, [in character voice] “Well now I think, you know, hunger on

the planet can be — we can stop hunger and we only have to change the way the world is governed.” And the guy said, “Where do you buy those clothes” or something. And we’d say, “Stevie’s going to goofland.
Like you know, at least here we’re trying to keep it in the context of music but he’d be way out there and you’d never remember what the question was.
Of course now I’m doing it.
Yeah, right, what was our question.
